priceData.title: Price Data Accuracy
priceData.content: This platform aggregates PSA 10 card price data from multiple markets including SNKRDUNK and eBay, striving to provide accurate and timely market information. However, as market prices fluctuate rapidly, the platform cannot guarantee that displayed prices are identical to actual transaction prices. All price information is for reference only; actual transaction prices are determined by each respective platform.

marketplaceDisclaimer.title: Marketplace Transaction Disclaimer
marketplaceDisclaimer.content: The Marketplace on this platform serves as an intermediary between buyers and sellers, providing only transaction matching services. The platform makes no guarantees regarding the authenticity, quality, legality, or accuracy of descriptions of items listed by sellers. Buyers should carefully read product descriptions and assess transaction risks independently before purchasing. The platform bears no direct legal liability for losses arising from inaccurate product descriptions, damaged goods, or other transaction disputes, but will make reasonable efforts to assist in dispute resolution.

investmentRisk.title: Investment Risk Disclaimer
investmentRisk.content: The market prices of PTCG cards (including PSA 10 graded cards) are influenced by various factors, including but not limited to market supply and demand, rarity, edition, and collecting trends. Any price information, trend analysis, or market data provided by this platform does not constitute investment advice. Users should independently assess risks; the platform accepts no responsibility for any investment losses resulting from reliance on platform information.

dataDelay.title: Data Delay Disclaimer
dataDelay.content: Price data on this platform is sourced from third-party platforms (SNKRDUNK, eBay, etc.) and may be subject to delays. Some data may not update in real time due to network conditions, API limitations, or technical reasons. The platform accepts no liability for any losses caused by data delays.

externalLinks.title: External Links Disclaimer
externalLinks.content: This platform may contain links to third-party platforms such as SNKRDUNK and eBay. These links are provided for reference only; the platform accepts no responsibility for the content, privacy policies, or terms of service of third-party platforms. Users accessing third-party platforms should comply with those platforms' terms of use.

serviceInterruption.title: Service Interruption Disclaimer
serviceInterruption.content: This platform may temporarily suspend services due to system maintenance, technical failures, network issues, or force majeure events. The platform will make every effort to ensure service stability but accepts no liability for any losses caused by service interruptions.

jurisdiction.title: Governing Law
jurisdiction.content: This disclaimer is governed by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. For any disputes arising from the use of this platform, both parties agree to submit to the jurisdiction of the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region as the court of first instance.

userConduct.title: User Conduct Guidelines
userConduct.content: Users must not engage in any illegal activities, infringe on the rights of others, or interfere with the normal operation of the platform when using this service. The platform reserves the right to take action against violating users, including but not limited to suspending or terminating their access.

dataPrivacy.title: Personal Data Protection
dataPrivacy.content: This platform values the protection of users' personal data. Personal data collected is used only for providing services, processing transactions, and improving user experience. For details on how personal data is handled, please refer to our Privacy Policy.
